ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with a ratio of approximately 1.0:1.1 between high-intensity (white) lateral regions and low-intensity (black) central/peduncle regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white regions occupy the outer 60% of both left and right lobes. A low-intensity dark pigment region forms a symmetric inverted triangle originating at the median notch and widening toward the peduncle base. Punctate dark spots are visible within the white field of the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:1.5 within the central cleft.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes varying from 3 to 8 pixels; the most prominent peaks are located on the distal thirds of both lobes, creating a jagged, irregular boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distal tips exhibit a sharp, tapering convexity directed postero-laterally; trailing edges maintain a generally linear to slightly concave sweep toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped clusters (approx. 20+ distinct marks) are visible within the dark central pigment, concentrated primarily in the superior half of the dark region near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct, near-vertical parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the inner-middle section of the right lobe, crossing the dark-to-light pigment boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular attachment scarring across the central fluke and small, irregular tissue voids/notches along the trailing edge periphery.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary between the central dark region and lateral white regions is characterized by a high-frequency mottled 'feathering' rather than a clean geometric gradient.
